Text: Ordinance number 640, amending nonunion. Nonunion employee classification plan. Attachment B, the proposed change to the nonunion employment classification plan. Attachment B is due to a new position, part time payroll and human resource specialists being proposed, as well as a replacement of an existing position finance human resource specialist with a new title accounting specialist, as well as a revised scope of duties.

Speaker: Speaker 11
Text: This newly created part time position stems from organizational realignment, designed to better support both the finance and human resources functions. While payrolls possibilities were listed under Finance Department and the former finance HR specialist. Job description. In practice, these duties have been managed by the HR director. Over time,  it became evident that having one role split between two departments created challenges and maintaining adequate support and focus across critical functions.

Speaker: Speaker 11
Text: The dual reporting model placed increased demands on the position, which affected the timely and thorough execution of HR functions such as recruitment, benefits, administration, compliance, and reporting. Following a comprehensive review, the city determined that a more sustainable structure was needed to support departmental needs and ensure operational efficiency. As a result, the duties have been restructured into two roles a tight a part time payroll and human resource specialists reporting to human resources will now handle payroll processing, along with support and recruitment, benefits and compliance, and a full time accounting specialist will focus solely on financial responsibilities, including accounts payable and accounts receivable.

Speaker: Speaker 11
Text: This proposal clarifies oversight, improves workflow, strengthens internal controls, and allows each department to operate more effectively. It also ensures better services to employees and retirees, reinforcing our commitment to supporting the workforce. These changes are requested by the Acting City Manager.
